purpose: Every text rcf-lite ships or prints about the build cycle states the 0.37.0 model: five stages named by commit prefix, TEST on a locally running app, Finalise light and pre-merge writing complete, Verify outside the cycle writing verified, rounds that restart at DEFINE after a failed verdict, and dispatches named by stage.
responsibilities: guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.md (the build loop, RULE 7, RULE 13, RULE 16) and its hash and harness fragment from scripts/gen-managed-artefacts.mjs
the bundle's closing runbook (src/build/bundle.js completionContract) in md and json
docs/verify-reference.md (the finalise synopsis, the modes section and the forward catalog contract) and the two READMEs
releases/releases.yaml: the 0.37.0 entry with minAgentAction rerun-init

interfaces.name: rcf guidance build-cycle (0.37.0 text)
interfaces.description: format: Markdown. One section per stage headed "DEFINE (commit prefix DEFINE:, role test-author)", "BUILD (BUILD:, builder)", "REVIEW (REVIEW:, reviewer)", "TEST (TEST:, verifier)", "FINALISE (FINALISE:, stage-keeper)"; TEST names "the full RCF suite against a locally running app" and "nothing is deployed"; FINALISE names "before the merge" and "writes complete"; a section "VERIFY (outside the build cycle)" names rcf verify run --record and "writes verified"; a section "Rounds" names the failed-verdict rule.

interfaces.name: Bundle closing runbook (0.37.0)
interfaces.description: format: the last section of rcf build bundle --format md, and completionContract in --format json. Lists the five stages in order, each with its dispatch name "<Stage> <fbs-id>: <title>", its commit prefix and its commands: DEFINE (criteria and RCF tests, rcf define validate), BUILD (rcf build base-suite on the base before dispatch), REVIEW (rcf build verdict review), TEST (the RCF suite run, rcf audit test-strength --record, rcf build verdict test), FINALISE (rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref>, then merge); then "Verify is outside the round: rcf verify run --release <label> --since <ref> --record before the promote".

interfaces.name: Release feed entry 0.37.0
interfaces.description: format: YAML entry in releases/releases.yaml, version 0.37.0 matching package.json, breaking true, minAgentAction rerun-init (one of the validator's set: rewrite-shell-invocations, rerun-init, regenerate-chain, schema-migration), summary naming the managed block change.
